english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is difficult to understand.
Use this when the main point is that an explanation or argument is hard to understand, rather than simply complex.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that is difficult to understand or interpret.
Use this when a passage, idea, reference, or explanation is difficult to understand.
Use this for wording, ideas, or explanations whose meaning is difficult to understand.
Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice when writing, speech, or an explanation is hard to understand.
Use this when the emphasis is that something is difficult to understand rather than abstract in nature.
